name: multiview-demo
// targets: MediaPackage V2 Dynamic MultiView demo stack. Pure CloudFormation (Fn::ForEach), so it deploys with aws cloudformation deploy and lints with cfn-lint (the SAM CLI cannot parse Fn::ForEach).

deploy.command: aws cloudformation deploy --template-file template.yaml --stack-name "trackflix-multiview-$STAGE" --parameter-overrides Stage="$STAGE" --capabilities CAPABILITY_IAM --tags Project=trackflix-live Owner="$STAGE" Name="trackflix-multiview-$STAGE" --region us-west-2 --no-fail-on-empty-changeset
